text:
maya: Hey infra team — we have a batch onboarding next month and need quota lifts in two regions. Requesting p5 from 8->24, g5 from 16->48, and ENI per subnet 120->250 in ap-south-1 and af-south-1 for two new accounts. These will be used for Dedicated GPU pools (tenant isolation). Need expedited if possible :pray:

ashok: Can you drop the account IDs + region codes and the business justification (short)? I'll open the AWS support cases. Also, do we have finance signoff?

maya: Account IDs: 123456789012 (org-onboard-1), 210987654321 (org-onboard-2). Regions: ap-south-1, af-south-1. Justification: 6 tenants, each needs 2-4 p5 instances steady with occasional spikes; latency SLOs require dedicated capacity. Finance approved an initial OPEX increase for 3 months. Tagging onboarding-tenant-2026.

riya: FYI ENI in af-south-1 is already near account ceiling for some subnets — we'll need subnet sizing + NAT gateway plan. IPv6 fallback might help if AWS pushes ENI limits.

ashok: Filing cases now. Template I'm using (so we have a record):
```
aws support create-case \
  --service-code "ec2" \
  --category-code "limits" \
  --severity-code "low" \
  --cc-email "infra@redwood.com" \
  --subject "Quota increase request: p5/g5/ENI ap-south-1 & af-south-1 for accounts 123456789012,210987654321" \
  --communication-body "Requesting accelerator and ENI quota increases to support Dedicated onboarding pools. See attached usage projection and architecture. Please expedite due to committed customer onboarding windows."
```

juan: Case created: 1122334455. Requested p5->24, g5->48, ENI->250 in both regions for both accounts. Marked as expedited. AWS asked for architecture diagram + expected sustained GPU/vCPU usage numbers.

cloud-ops-bot: [automated] AWS case 1122334455 updated: support engineer requested additional capacity projection and subnet details.

maya: Uploaded a simple topology + per-tenant instance projection (2-4 p5 each, 2-3 g5 for burst) and projected sustained GPU usage ~60% over 24h windows. Also included planned start date and customer names.

ashok: If AWS pushes back on ENI, propose one of: 1) use larger subnets + reserve private IPv4; 2) enable IPv6 fallback for pod-level traffic; 3) fall back to shared hosted pool in eu-west-2 temporarily. Which is preferred?

juan: I asked AWS about fallback capacity; added a note to permit cross-region bursting into eu-west-2 as a short-term fallback. AWS asked about bursting patterns — I provided 60% sustained with 2x spikes lasting ~30m.

riya: Quick cost note: full-provisioned monthly delta estimated ~ $45k. Finance ok for 3 months ramp. We should start with 50% of requested capacity first and escalate after we validate traffic.

maya: Sounds good. We'll start with 50% provisioning for week 1. I'll update the onboarding runbook, add subnet/NAT steps, and tag eng-sre for VPC checks. Thanks all :thumbsup:

eng-sre: On VPC sizing, please include the following in the runbook: 
- reserved /22 per tenant subnet plan
- NAT gateway budget and HA plan
- ENI headroom target 20% above requested
We'll review once AWS responds to the case.

maya: noted — I'll push the updated runbook and paste the link here once done.

juan: AWS responded provisional approval for p5/g5 increases in ap-south-1, final review pending for af-south-1; ENI increase pending more subnet detail. Will update case 1122334455 when they confirm ETA.

maya: thanks — tagging @ashok @riya to follow up on subnet details.

ashok: leaving a calendar reminder to check the support case in 48 hours.

maya: appreciated — will keep thread updated.
